description: Defines the YearStatistics class that extends Statistics to compute statistics related to books read in the current year, including finding the least and most liked books and computing average ratings.

classes.name: YearStatistics
classes.description: A class that calculates statistics about books read in the current year, including identifying the least liked, most liked, and calculating the average rating of these books.

methods.name: YearStatistics
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the statistics and finds books read this year.

methods.name: findReadBooksAddedThisYear
methods.description: Filters and returns books that have been started reading in the current year with a rating.

methods.name: findLeastLikedBookThisYear
methods.description: Returns the least liked book read this year, if any.

methods.name: findMostLikedBookThisYear
methods.description: Returns the most liked book read this year, if any.

methods.name: calculateAverageRatingGivenThisYear
methods.description: Calculates the average rating of books read this year.

methods.name: calculateTotalRating
methods.description: Sums the ratings of books read this year.
